Comment authors can now edit their own comments. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked.

- **API:** `features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` is new. It has the Zod schema (`body` required), an `updateComment` fetcher doing `PATCH /comments/{commentId}`, and a `useUpdateComment` hook. On success the hook invalidates the comments query.
- **Success message:** the hook shows a "Comment Updated" notification itself. `features/CLAUDE.md` says success notifications go in the `api/` hook, not in components. The existing create and delete comment components still show theirs in the component, which that rule says not to do. I didn't touch them.
- **Edit button:** `features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx` is new. It's an "Edit Comment" button that opens a form drawer, pre-filled with the current body.
- **Comments list:** `comments-list.tsx` shows the Edit button only when `comment.author?.id` matches the current user. That means an admin sees Edit only on their own comments, though they still see Delete on all of them.
- **Mock API:** I added a `PATCH /comments/:commentId` handler to `testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts` so the dev environment works. It only updates a comment if the caller is its author.
